name: linux-cleanup
description: Safe, modular disk + cache cleanup for Linux: idle-only pruning of yarn/npm/pnpm, browser, Gradle, Cypress, Playwright and Android caches, stale node_modules, journals and old snaps — allowlist-guarded, with a real --dry-run.

scripts.lint:bash: bash -c 'for f in cleanup.sh lib/*.sh modules/*.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done' && node -c bin/linux-cleanup.js
scripts.version:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const v=require('./package.json').version;const ok=fs.readFileSync('VERSION','utf8').trim()===v&&fs.readFileSync('lib/common.sh','utf8').includes('LINUX_CLEANUP_VERSION=\"'+v+'\"')&&fs.readFileSync('release/stable.env','utf8').includes('version='+v);if(!ok){console.error('version mismatch: package.json '+v+' must equal VERSION, lib/common.sh and release/stable.env');process.exit(1)}console.log('version parity OK: '+v)"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run --silent lint:bash && test -x cleanup.sh && test -x bin/linux-cleanup.js && npm run --silent version:check
